نبذة

LeBeauty Studio is Mandurah’s premier beauty destination, bringing beauty, artistry and confidence together under one roof. Set within our luxury, dark and moody studio, we offer an extensive range of personalised services, including cosmetic tattooing, lash extensions and lifts, brows, advanced skin treatments, nails, waxing, makeup, massage, body treatments and professional hairdressing. Our talented team is passionate about creating beautiful, individualised results while ensuring every client feels comfortable, confident and cared for. From enhancing your natural features to refreshing your skin, hair or nails, every treatment is tailored to your unique style and needs. We’re also committed to becoming a more sustainable salon, making conscious choices to reduce waste and minimise our environmental footprint wherever possible, while continuing to deliver exceptional service and results. At LeBeauty Studio, enjoy expert care, a welcoming atmosphere and an elevated beauty experience designed to leave you looking and feeling your absolute best.
